title: Vendor Independence Policy
description: The Foundation maintains provider-agnostic abstractions for all critical infrastructure. No single vendor dependency is permitted.

sections.heading: Abstraction
sections.body: All external service integrations must be behind provider-agnostic interfaces. Adherence to ADR-0002 is mandatory.

sections.heading: Review
sections.body: The Architecture Board reviews all new dependencies for vendor lock-in risk during the ADR approval process.
